usedFor: Razorpay holds refunds, and Jandi gets a team message when “A New Refund Is Created” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “A New Refund Is Created” in Razorpay, then “Send Jandi Webhook Message” in Jandi
bestTemplate.why: Your team sees every refund in Jandi as it is created, with no one checking Razorpay by hand.

watchOut: “Send Jandi Webhook Message” posts to a Jandi webhook, so point it at the right one before turning it on.
